messages:
Diana (oncall): @here Alert: healthcheck trending - east-asia-1 gpu pool reporting 100% unschedulable. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Automatic detector triggered: region_capacity_saturation(east-asia-1) at 2026-03-18T04:03:19Z. p99_latency_up, queue_depth rising.
Alice (ops): Seeing spike in provisioning errors from the autoscaler: "Insufficient resources: no nodes available matching GPUv100". Any manual capacity left?
Bob (sre): Confirmed. control-plane shows pod eviction rate jumped. K8s events:
```
FailedScheduling: 0/50 nodes are available: 50 Insufficient gpu.
``` 
Carol (platform): Traffic to east-asia-1 is 78% of normal. Our canary fallback policy is set to trigger at 60% healthy, why didn't it kick?
Eve (network): LB shows health checks failing to backend pool; mark unhealthy after >3 consecutive fails. Failures started ~04:00Z.
Diana (oncall): Action items: 1) Isolate root cause (hardware vs network vs control-plane). 2) Kick traffic shift to other regions manually if needed. 3) Notify support and sales for customer impact.
Alice (ops): I can attempt manual scale-up in us-central-1 and west-europe-2 but we may hit quota limits for GPU types. Suggest manual failover first to avoid queuing.
Bob (sre): Node telemetry shows NVLink errors and host watchdog reboots on several machines. Correlating with provider events now. No scheduled maint we own.
Carol (platform): Canary didn't shift because session affinity is sticky for critical routes. Need an override to ignore affinity for health decisions.
Eve (network): I can set east-asia-1 pool weight=0 to stop new sessions. Will that trigger cross-region failover for stateless routes? :+1:
Diana (oncall): Do it. Also set `canary_override=true` in rollout controller to force fallback.
infra-bot: Runbook step executed by Eve: traffic_weight_update east-asia-1 -> 0 at 2026-03-18T04:08:43Z.
Alice (ops): Kicked off provisioning of 50 GPUs in us-central-1 with `prefer_spot=false` to avoid preemption. Est warm-up ~5m.
Bob (sre): Temporarily bumped autoscaler to allow bursts beyond quota for 10m. Will need finance sign-off for potential cost impact. @Finance (finance) please ack.
Carol (platform): Cross-region shift increases egress and could affect SLOs for stateful endpoints. Recommend routing only stateless inference to fallback regions.
Diana (oncall): Update: New request errors dropped from 12% -> 2% after weight=0. Long-lived sessions still see ~3% errors.
Alice (ops): Initial provisioning succeeded for 20 GPUs in us-central-1. Hooked into pool and running canary.
Bob (sre): Canary latency looks comparable. Starting rollout: move 30% of critical stateless routes to us-central-1.
Carol (platform): Rollout applied. Cost alert: if sustained, egress could be ~2.4x baseline this hour. :money_with_wings:
Eve (network): LB drain logs: 94% flows drained. Remaining flows are long-lived enterprise streams; will need manual migration or customer communication.
Diana (oncall): Support please prepare outreach for top 5 impacted customers. @Support (support-team)
Alice (ops): Forensics: at least 7 hosts showed hardware failures; captured host IDs and logs and opened provider ticket.
Bob (sre): Postmortem items: hardware correlation, sticky-session canary bug, missing early provider health alert. Assigning owners and timelines.
Carol (platform): Short-term follow-ups: 1) Fix canary override automation 2) Auto-shift only for stateless endpoints 3) Add provider-host-health alert earlier in pipeline.
Diana (oncall): Status: region degraded but traffic shifted. Incident remains open until provider confirms root cause and long-lived sessions recovered. Next update in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Eve (network): Provider acknowledged suspected rack-level power issue; ETA for hardware replacement 2-3 hours. Will update.
Alice (ops): Logged emergency egress cost and requested temporary credits. @Finance (finance) please advise on immediate approvals.
infra-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, impact=partial-regional-outage, started=1769009999.
Diana (oncall): Thanks all. Ping here for any change. End of initial triage.
